note: Approved isolated lab DEFINITIONS. No vulnerable environment starts automatically. Launching any lab requires explicit user action, authorization, an isolation check, and approval. Oyster only records how to install/isolate/clean up — it does not run these.

items.name: OWASP Juice Shop
items.purpose: Modern intentionally-vulnerable web app for training web-appsec skills.
items.installation_method: docker run (local) or npm; use a pinned image tag.
items.isolation_requirements: Run on an isolated host/VM or a dedicated bridge network; never expose to the internet.
items.cleanup_procedure: docker rm -f the container and remove the image/volume.

items.name: OWASP WebGoat
items.purpose: Guided lessons for common web vulnerabilities.
items.installation_method: docker run or the provided JAR; pinned version.
items.cleanup_procedure: Stop and remove the container/JAR process; delete data dir.

items.name: DVWA
items.purpose: Damn Vulnerable Web Application — classic PHP/MySQL vuln lab.
items.isolation_requirements: Isolated VM; never internet-exposed (intentionally trivially exploitable).

items.name: Vulhub
items.purpose: Pre-built docker-compose environments for specific CVEs.
items.installation_method: docker-compose up within a specific CVE directory.
items.isolation_requirements: Dedicated disposable VM; tear down immediately after use (real CVEs).
items.cleanup_procedure: docker-compose down -v in the environment directory.

items.name: pwn.college
items.purpose: Structured curriculum for binary exploitation / systems security.
items.installation_method: Hosted platform / dojo containers per their instructions.
items.isolation_requirements: Use their sandboxed dojo; keep separate from engagement infra.

items.name: Atomic Red Team
items.purpose: Library of small, mapped ATT&CK tests for detection validation (purple team).
items.installation_method: Invoke-AtomicRedTeam (PowerShell) in a dedicated test host.
items.isolation_requirements: Dedicated, monitored, disposable test host — these execute real (benign) attack techniques.
items.network_requirements: Isolated; some atomics touch the network — review each before running.
items.cleanup_procedure: Run the atomic's cleanup command; revert the host snapshot.

excluded.name: TryHackMe
excluded.reason: Do NOT ingest or scrape. Its proprietary content and current terms prohibit systematic extraction and competing-model use without permission. Documented here so it is explicitly out of scope for ingestion.
